scene_00_intro.text: You arrive at a sprawling Hollywood Hills mansion. Music, laughter, and the clink of glasses fill the air. The party stretches in all directions.

scene_bar_01.text: A long marble bar with a neon backlight. Guests lean in across the counter. One figure catches your eye.

scene_pool_01.text: The pool shimmers under string lights. Laughter and splashes come from clusters of people. Someone dives with effortless grace.

scene_lounge_01.text: Velvet sofas and low tables—an intimate corner of the party. A lone figure studies a painting nearby.

scene_balcony_01.text: The balcony looks out over the city lights. Music turns distant here—an ideal spot for private conversation.

scene_observatory_01.text: A private game loft dome lined with telescopes and cushions. A figure practices an elegant stretch near the rail.

scene_harper_00_intro.text: Harper stands at the bar, turning as you approach with a knowing smile.

scene_riley_00_intro.text: Riley stretches gracefully in the game loft light, giving you a playful nod.

scene_mara_00_intro.text: Mara turns from the balcony view, her eyes warm and inviting.

scene_luna_soft_01.text: A soft and slower moment unfolds with Luna.

scene_luna_intense_01.text: Luna steps closer, intensity in her eyes.

scene_return_00.text: You return to the party's main flow.
